description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 29.09.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous notification - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names P. S. M. Charles as Director General of Customs, this is only to establish authority and does not constitute a personnel appointment or describe portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify as a government-related type (1-3).
